metadata.title: OpenSoundDeck - The Open Source Soundboard
metadata.description: Cross-platform, open-source soundboard for voice chats and streams. Inject audio directly into your microphone with global hotkeys.

features.title: What is OpenSoundDeck?
features.description: OpenSoundDeck is an open-source application that lets you play sounds through your microphone. Built with C++20 and Qt6 for maximum performance and minimal latency.

micInjection.title: Mic Injection
micInjection.description: Plays audio files so they sound like they are coming from your microphone.

globalHotkeys.title: Global Hotkeys
globalHotkeys.description: Assign system-wide hotkeys to your favorite sounds so you can trigger them from anywhere, even inside a game.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-Platform
crossPlatform.description: A single native application that runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

soundMixing.title: Sound & Mic Mixing
soundMixing.description: Your voice and the played audio are mixed together seamlessly. Your friends will still hear you speak!

simpleUI.title: Simple UI
simpleUI.description: An easy-to-use interface to manage your sound library and configure devices.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: 100% Free & Open-Source. Built with transparency and a passion for great software.

lowLatency.title: Low Latency
lowLatency.description: Written in C++20 with the Qt framework for a responsive, native experience with minimal latency.

statistics.title: The open source soundboard
statistics.description: With a growing community of contributors and users worldwide.

privacy.title: Built for privacy first
privacy.description: OpenSoundDeck does not store any of your data. All audio processing happens locally on your machine. We do not collect analytics, telemetry, or usage data. Your sounds, your data, your privacy.

whatIs.question: What is OpenSoundDeck?
whatIs.answer: OpenSoundDeck is a free and open-source application that allows you to play sounds through your microphone input for others to hear. Whether you are gaming with friends, live-streaming, or on a conference call, you can play sound effects, music, or clips at the press of a button.

howToUse.question: How do I use OpenSoundDeck?
howToUse.answer: After installing, configure your audio devices in the settings. Set your microphone as input, virtual cable as output, and your headphones for monitoring. Then simply add sound files to your library and assign hotkeys to trigger them.

extraSoftware.question: Do I need extra software?
extraSoftware.answer: On Windows, you need VB-Audio Virtual Cable. On macOS, you need BlackHole. On Linux, everything works automatically via PulseAudio/PipeWire. The app will guide you through setup on first run.

free.question: Is it free to use?
free.answer: Yes! OpenSoundDeck is completely free and open-source under the GPL-3.0 license. No ads, no paywalls, just pure functionality.

discord.question: Can I use it with Discord/Zoom/Teams?
discord.answer: Absolutely! OpenSoundDeck works with any application that uses your microphone. Simply select the virtual cable as your microphone input in the app settings.

formats.question: What audio formats are supported?
formats.answer: OpenSoundDeck supports MP3, WAV, OGG, and FLAC formats. You can add any number of sounds to your library.

dataPrivate.question: Is my data private?
dataPrivate.answer: Yes! OpenSoundDeck does not store any of your data. Everything is processed locally on your machine. We do not collect analytics or telemetry.

contribute.question: Can I contribute?
contribute.answer: Yes! We welcome contributions of all kinds. Check out our GitHub repository for open issues and contribution guidelines.

engine.title: Powered by miniaudio
engine.description: OpenSoundDeck uses miniaudio, a fantastic single-file audio library written in C. It provides cross-platform audio playback and capture with minimal latency. Combined with our custom ring buffer mixer, you get professional audio quality with rock-solid performance.

windows.title: Windows Requirements
windows.description: You need to install VB-Audio Virtual Cable before using OpenSoundDeck. The app will guide you through setup on first run.

macos.title: macOS Requirements
macos.description: You need to install BlackHole virtual audio driver. Run brew install blackhole-2ch or download manually.

linux.title: Linux Notes
linux.description: No additional drivers required! OpenSoundDeck automatically creates virtual audio devices via PulseAudio or PipeWire.

whatIs.title: What is OpenSoundDeck?
items: Play sound effects, music, or audio clips through your microphone
Works with Discord, Zoom, Teams, and any voice chat application
Global hotkeys to trigger sounds from anywhere (even while gaming)

audioSetup.title: Audio Devices Setup
steps: Select your microphone as Input Device
Select virtual cable as Output Device
Select your headphones/speakers as Monitor Device
Adjust volume levels for each device

addingSounds.title: Adding Sounds
steps: Click the + button in the main window
Select an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, or FLAC)
Assign a hotkey by clicking the hotkey field and pressing your desired key combination
Test the sound by clicking the play button or pressing the hotkey

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: OpenSoundDeck does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All audio processing and sound playback happens locally on your machine. We do not use analytics, telemetry, or any tracking mechanisms.

localStorage.title: Local Storage
localStorage.content: All your settings, hotkeys, and sound library information is stored locally in your user configuration directory. This data never leaves your computer.

audioData.title: Audio Data
audioData.content: OpenSoundDeck processes audio in real-time on your device. No audio data is recorded, transmitted, or stored by the application. Your microphone input and played sounds remain entirely under your control.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: The application does not communicate with any external servers or third-party services. The only network activity is when you explicitly choose to download virtual audio drivers (Windows/macOS) or check for updates.

contactForm.title: Contact Form
contactForm.content: When using our encrypted contact form, your message is encrypted with PGP in your browser before being sent. Only the intended recipient can decrypt and read your message.
